summary: DEON AS (org. no. 997 850 289) is a private limited company (AS) based in Drammen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2012-01-18. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 73.110 (Reklamebyråvirksomhet). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 280 630 and net income was -NOK 6 406. Board chair: Hilde Sørby.
